More than a wishlist, an experience!

Wishlist Plus empowers shoppers to save products and seamlessly continue their journey across website, mobile app, and retail stores. The best Wishlist available!

Features include automated reminders, multiple wishlists, personalized account pages, sales and service team access for personalized customer interactions.

Wishlist increases sales by 20-30%
Explore

Save demand with Save for Later.

Let your shoppers effortlessly save items from the cart with a single click, ensuring no purchase is forgotten.

Easily integrate one-click saves and display saved items on the cart page to keep shoppers engaged. Automated reminders via SMS, email, and push notifications bring them back to complete their purchase.

Explore

Bring shoppers back with Back in Stock alerts

Enable shoppers to sign up for notifications when out-of-stock or pre-order items become available.

Features include customizable alerts, product or variant-level subscriptions, pre-order and coming soon alerts, and the ability for your sales staff to sign up customers in-store via Shopify POS.

Explore

Gift registries and shopping lists for any occasion

Create a seamless gifting experience for customers by making it easy for them to create and share lists for any occasion.

Enable your customers with multiple registries, gift tracking, personalised thank-you notes, inspiration browsing, with support for anonymous gifting.

Explore

Add a human touch to your online experience

Turn your website into a one-on-one collaboration tool for your sales and service teams.

Empower your sales associates to view customer wishlists, curate and share personalized recommendations, configure alerts, and engage customers online & in-store. Turn abandoned wishlists into valuable sales leads.

Explore

Boost sales with highly targeted campaigns

Supercharge your marketing with laser-focused campaigns driven by rich low-funnel data.

Engage with SMS, push, and email campaigns seamlessly through your ESP. Create advanced customer segments and automate price drop, low stock & back in stock alerts for maximum impact.

30 to 35% click-through rate on alerts
